description: Tighter rule set: narrower tolerance override and a shorter max step duration. Demonstrates that a rule set is just config — no code change needed to retune review strictness.

rules.description: Actual value must be within a tighter 2% tolerance regardless of the step's own setting.
Equipment must not be DOWN, DISCONFIGURED, or IN_MAINTENANCE.
Any operator comment on a step is routed to a reviewer.
UV280 absorbance must stay within a tighter 0-2.0 AU band.
No step should run longer than 120 minutes without review.
The same user cannot both perform and review a step.
